name: Marshal Dughan
summary: In Goldshire, Marshal Dughan holds the roads against threats from the mines and woods. He commands Stormwind's small army detachment, stretched thin by kobolds, gnolls, and bandits. To guard the town and nearby farms, he depends on independent adventurers.

sections.title: Commander of the Crossroads
sections.body: From Goldshire, Marshal Dughan directs Elwynn Forest's defense outside the Lion's Pride Inn. Stormwind's soldiers are tied up elsewhere as trouble grows in the woods. Kobolds crowd the mines, gnolls gather along the riverbanks, and highwaymen harass travelers on the King's Road. With too few footmen, Dughan sends new recruits to reinforce outposts and scout dangerous ground.

sections.title: Threats on Every Border
sections.body: Kobolds overrun Fargodeep and Jasperlode Mines, threatening Goldshire's mineral supply. West of town, Hogger's Riverpaw gnolls press against Westbrook Garrison. Eastward, Guard Thomas reports vicious murlocs killing patrols along the river. Dughan has too few soldiers to meet each threat, so he needs capable mercenaries to help contain them.

faq.answer: Marshal Dughan commands a Stormwind Army detachment in Goldshire. He coordinates Elwynn Forest's defenses against thieves, gnolls, and kobolds.

faq.q: Why doesn't Dughan send more guards to help Westbrook Garrison or the east?
faq.answer: Stormwind's forces are spread thin, leaving Dughan barely enough guards to keep order in Goldshire. He has too few soldiers for every farm and border post, so he relies on visiting adventurers to scout danger, carry dispatches, and confront local threats.

faq.q: What is Dughan's view on the murloc threat in Elwynn?
faq.answer: Dughan first dismissed Remy 'Two Times' warnings that murlocs threatened the region. Guard Thomas's reports of Rolf Hartford and Malakai Stone's deaths along the eastern waterways convinced him of the danger.

faq.q: How does Dughan handle local crime and rowdy civilians?
faq.answer: Dughan is charged with keeping peace in Goldshire and the surrounding lands. He says order is hard enough to keep amid Elwynn's new troubles, and focuses on kobolds to the north and gnolls and thieves to the west.

faq.q: Why is Dughan concerned about the mines?
faq.answer: Fargodeep Mine and Jasperlode Mine supply Stormwind with gold and ore. Kobolds have overrun both mines, driven out the miners, and threaten to tunnel beneath Elwynn's settlements.

faq.q: Does Marshal Dughan coordinate with Westfall?
faq.answer: Yes. After you prove capable in Elwynn Forest, Dughan sends you to report to Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. The People's Militia needs veteran help against the Defias Brotherhood.

angles.text: As an Alliance recruit in Elwynn, you receive your first military assignments from Marshal Dughan, Stormwind's local authority.
As a warrior, you see Stormwind's footmen hold the line with discipline despite impossible odds and too few soldiers.
